findings.claim: The release matrix now builds the Windows `surreal-remote` release surface without installing the MSVC SurrealDB build prerequisites that the workflow itself says are required.
findings.evidence: The diff adds `cargo build --release --locked -p compass-cli --bin compass --features surreal-remote --target ${{ matrix.target }}` to the native release matrix before the Windows installer step, while the separate Windows SurrealDB job comments that `surrealdb-core hard-enables jsonwebtoken/aws-lc-rs, so aws-lc-sys is built for every SurrealDB feature and needs CMake plus NASM on MSVC` and installs NASM only in that other job.
findings.suggested_fix: Install the same MSVC prerequisites, including NASM on Windows, in the release matrix before building with `--features surreal-remote`, or move the Windows release build to a job that already provisions them.
